label: SEOClerks
terms_note: Public read-only listing API; selling / bidding in the UI.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (read-only listings URL API). Lane `assist` → **keep**. Confidence high.

endpoints.call: API URL for Services / Trades / Job Listings
endpoints.notes: ad title, price, seller, link (HTML or component output)

reference.limits: - Read-only; orders / job offers in the UI. - Public read-only listing API; selling / bidding in the UI.

adapter.rate_note: The Service Ads API page publishes no rate limit; the API is a keyless GET. One request per second.
adapter.terms: SEOClerks Service Ads API (https://www.seoclerks.com/api/page/serviceads) is intended for embedding listings (optionally with an affiliate id); buyers' job requests are answered by sellers logged in on seoclerks.com.

search_postings.note: GET https://www.seoclerks.com/api?type=inlinead&dt=wtb&s=<query>&c=<category>&am=<limit>&oby=bidstart&f=json — the Service Ads API builder with 'Search Where' = Jobs (dt=wtb, buyers' want-to-buy requests), 'Search Term' s (matched against titles), 'Category' c (numeric id from the builder's category list, e.g. 64 Graphics & Logos), 'Amount to Select' am (Max: 40), 'Order By' Start Date (oby=bidstart, newest first) and 'Output Type' JSON. The API has no paging, so only the first `limit` matches are returned (page is ignored). No match answers a bare JSON null body: the Python runtime returns an empty list, the TypeScript runtime currently reports it as an internal_error (treat that as 'no results'). The buyer's budget is raw.price (a string, USD) and delivery days raw.days; create_date/last_update are Unix timestamps in raw. min_budget is not sent (the 'Minimum Price' option applies to services, not job requests).

not_offered.get_posting: The API only selects lists of ads; there is no per-listing call. Re-read the record from the search hit (service_url opens the request).
not_offered.submit_bid: No offer API; sellers respond to job requests on seoclerks.com while logged in.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the Service Ads API is read-only listings.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the Service Ads API is read-only listings.
